I was really disappointed with this spreadsheet. Several features simply do not work as expected.

The check boxes on the Wishlist tab do not function at all, which makes that section unusable. The Dashboard page also has multiple issues — the Book Rating spreadsheet isn’t working, and there is a dummy sample that cannot be removed, which makes the dashboard feel unfinished.

Additionally, the explanation video for the spreadsheet is confusing. The audio is in English, but the spreadsheet shown in the video is not in English, which makes it difficult to follow along or understand how things are supposed to work.

Overall, this spreadsheet needs significant fixes before it can be considered functional or user-friendly.

From my experience, there were several coding issues when I began adding books to the tracker. The alternating row colours were not functioning correctly, which resulted in formatting inconsistencies, and I ultimately had to delete and rebuild the affected sections, which took approximately 45 minutes. After that, I attempted to add filters to the columns, which required another 45 minutes to set up properly (Not sure why it didnt have this before). I did not encounter the same level of instability with the previous tracker I used.
I thought this was a good chose as it had more features theb my old tracker. However, I would not purchase it again or recommend it to others. In my experience, it requires a working understanding of Google Sheets and basic coding/formatting functions to use effectively.
